entities.name: UniProt Q46633 AmsC
observations: Exact sequence match (100% identity and coverage; E=8.84e-261) to reviewed Erwinia amylovora amylovoran biosynthesis protein AmsC.
AmsC is involved in biosynthesis of amylovoran, a virulence factor; UniProt places it in the cell membrane as a multipass membrane protein.
375 aa; calculated molecular mass 42,569.9 Da, pI 9.17, GRAVY 0.8083, and predicted charge at pH 7 +8.88.
Curated reference annotates nine helical transmembrane regions at residues 2-22, 31-51, 93-113, 162-182, 208-228, 256-276, 287-307, 309-329, and 337-357.
Pfam detects EpsG family domain PF14897 (residues 36-365; i-Evalue 1.4e-28); no catalytic reaction was retrieved.
